fusions.name: Hurled Point
fusions.desc: Hurls a point that deals 30 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Barbed Salvo
fusions.desc: Looses 3 barbs at once, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Aim at the Door
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown Instinct
fusions.desc: When you cover ground, your physical damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
